part: P5A Part 27 -- Real-scale segment discovery index
mechanism: src/ops/transfer_cold_store.segment_name_for_month(year, month) -- deterministic O(1) filename derivation from a block_time's (year, month), cross-checked against each segment's own segment_manifest.month_covered.

scaling_timing.note: indexed approach opens ZERO files to determine the candidate segment set -- it computes filenames directly from the query's time range, then only opens the segments actually selected for the real data query (not for discovery).
